title: The Scarecrow's Blessing
subtitle: Paid without telling anybody, and it grants a stage
description: The scarecrow takes its cut in silence: the reward below is
`auto: invisible`, which grants it without telling the player --
and, like `no_toast`, suppresses the completion notice. The
blessing arrives as an emerald the player did not see granted and
a stage they were not told about: `my_pack:blessed`, written by a
stage reward, read by the old flags later in the week.
The village has opinions about whether a blessing one is not told
about still counts. The engine's answer is yes.
